notes: 6-digit integral invoice number. A leading 'C' marks a cancellation in the original UCI dataset convention.
business_meaning: Used to group transaction lines into a single customer purchase event and to identify cancellations ('C' prefix).

notes: 5-digit integral product (item) code. May be alphanumeric (e.g. '85123A').
business_meaning: Used to distinguish products and to compute product-level diversity features per customer.

notes: Product (item) name as recorded in the invoice line.
business_meaning: Free-text product label. Useful for product taxonomy work, but **not** used directly as a clustering feature.

notes: The quantities of each product (item) per transaction.
business_meaning: Used (after preprocessing decisions) to derive monetary value and basket-size features.

notes: Day and time when each transaction was generated.
business_meaning: Used to compute Recency and purchase-cadence features at the customer level.

notes: Product price per unit, in sterling (£).
business_meaning: Used (after preprocessing decisions) to compute Monetary (= sum(Quantity * UnitPrice)) per customer.

notes: 5-digit integral customer number, unique per customer. Missing in ~24.93% of rows in the raw primary file.
business_meaning: Customer-level join key for the modelling unit. Cannot meaningfully aggregate customers without this column.

notes: Name of the country where each customer resides.
business_meaning: Behavioural attribute used for segmentation by geography. Mostly UK in the raw data (~91.4%).
